text_block_list.text:
I don't know how many times I raced
Tannhauser
on the beach... Nature never
told us to stop.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Then Urara went off on her own to that
deserted
island, and Rice wouldn't stop
crying...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
This has been the most tiring camp since
I entered
Tracen.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин
choice_data_list: But you look like you had fun!

text_block_list.text:
Like hell I do! You want your butt
kicked?!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
We have some truly enriching days
leading up to
the autumn Tenno Sho!
